data.title: before-testing
data.description: AWS Certification uses beta exams to validate performance of exam questions before the questions are used on standard versions of an exam.
data.content:
### Creating an AWS Certification Account

To schedule a certification exam, you must first create an AWS Certification Account. Your AWS Certification Account is a central management tool for AWS Certification, allowing you to schedule exams and take advantage of certification benefits.

You will need an AWS Certification Account, which is separate from your AWS account, to participate in the AWS Certification program. To create an AWS Certification Account, go to [aws.training/Certification](https://aws.training/Certification) and choose Sign In. Follow directions for creating an AWS Builder ID. More detailed instructions are available in the [AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/signin/latest/userguide/sign-in-aws_builder_id.html?icmpid=docs_builder_id_console).

If you have any account issues, visit the [AWS Certification Account FAQ](https://www.aws.training/Support#certification) for details on how to submit a case to AWS Training and Certification Customer Service. Account issues include updating the name on your account to match your proof of identification and merging multiple accounts.

### Testing options

AWS Certification exams are currently offered through Pearson VUE. Learn more about the AWS Certification Test Delivery Provider, Pearson VUE, on our [FAQ page](https://aws.amazon.com/certification/faqs/).

### Finding a test center

To find a testing center, visit [Pearson VUE](https://wsr.pearsonvue.com/testtaker/registration/SelectTestCenterProximity/AWS?conversationId=965018) to find a date, time, and location convenient for you.

### AWS Exam Demo and functionality

Use the AWS Exam Demo tool to become familiar with the user interface and features of an AWS Certification exam, including color contrast options, identifying questions to review again later in the exam, and the English-language toggle for translated exams. To access the AWS Exam Demo, visit the AWS page at [Pearson VUE](https://www.pearsonvue.com/us/en/aws.html#links) and select “AWS Exam Demo”.

### Online proctored exams

Online proctoring is available for all AWS Certification exams from our test delivery provider Pearson VUE. Review the information below for details on testing options available:

Proctoring Languages and Availability at Pearson VUE:

-   English 24x7
-   Japanese: Monday – Saturday, 9 a.m. - 4 p.m. Local Time/JST
-   Spanish (Latin America): Monday - Friday, 10:00 a.m. - 5:45 p.m. EST
-   Mandarin (for customers in Mainland China): Monday - Friday, 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m. Local Time/CST

Exams at Pearson VUE:

-   All AWS Certification Exams.
-   Candidates who sign up for a localized exam can also view questions in English during the exam by using the toggle feature.

_Note that communication with a proctor is required to complete an online-proctored appointment._

### Scheduling

To schedule an AWS Certification exam through your AWS Certification Account, complete the following steps:

1.  Sign in to aws.training/Certification.
2.  Select the Go to your Account button, followed by the Schedule New Exam button. 
3.  Find the exam you wish to take, and then select Schedule with Pearson VUE.
4.  You will then be redirected to your Pearson VUE dashboard to select your testing location, date, and time for testing. Follow the prompts to purchase your exam. You will receive a confirmation email once you have purchased your exam.
5.  Please review the confirmation email in its entirety. This email contains pertinent details on the policies and terms for your upcoming exam appointment.

### Rescheduling or cancelling

To reschedule or cancel an exam, complete the following steps:

1.  Sign in to aws.training/Certification.
2.  Select the Go to your Account button. 
3.  Select the Manage Pearson VUE Exams button.
4.  You will then be redirected to the Pearson VUE dashboard where you can select on the exam in the Upcoming Appointments menu. 

Please note: You can reschedule your exam up to 24 hours before your scheduled exam time. Each exam appointment can only be rescheduled twice. If you need to reschedule your exam a third time, you will need to cancel your exam and schedule it for a more convenient date. If you paid for your exam using a voucher, verify the voucher expiration date prior to modifying your existing registration. Exam voucher expiration dates cannot be extended.

You will not be able to cancel or reschedule your exam within 24 hours of your scheduled exam appointment. Within 24 hours of the exam time, our test delivery provider will charge the full delivery fee and refunds are not available. In cases of personal illness or unforeseen emergencies, and with appropriate documentation, the test delivery provider will waive the fee and allow the exam to be rescheduled without charging additional fees. To request an excused absence, contact [Pearson VUE](https://www.pearsonvue.com/us/en/aws.html#contact) accordingly.

### Cancellation policy

You must contact Pearson VUE (refer to the contact information above) or access your online account to cancel your exam a minimum of 24 hours prior to your appointment. Canceling your exam less than 24 hours prior to your appointment, or failing to appear for your appointment, will result in the forfeiture of your exam fee.

### Candidate information, sharing, access, and data privacy

To offer certifications, AWS needs to collect some personal information about you, but we will never sell your personal information to others. We share personal information only as described in the [AWS Privacy Policy,](https://aws.amazon.com/privacy/) and with Amazon.com, Inc. and the subsidiaries that Amazon.com, Inc. controls that are either subject to the [AWS Privacy Policy](https://aws.amazon.com/privacy/) or follow practices at least as protective as those described in the policy.

The AWS Training and Certification team complies with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) by providing a way for European Union members to request the deletion of personal data and by providing candidates with their personal data with a description of how it is used. We will also systematically notify you if an account breach occurs. You can find more details in AWS Training and Certification’s [GDPR compliance FAQ](https://www.aws.training/Support#general-information).  

### Other countries, out-of-country testing, and sanctioned/embargoed countries

AWS Certification exams are not delivered in countries that are subject to sanctions or otherwise designated on any list of prohibited or restricted parties, including but not limited: to the lists maintained by the United Nations Security Council; the United States Government; the European Union or its member states; or any other applicable government authority. Our test delivery providers are committed to complying with applicable laws in the countries in which we operate, including international sanctions that may restrict us from providing services in, or to residents of, certain countries. A list of countries where AWS exams are delivered may be found during exam scheduling for Pearson VUE test centers.

To sit for an AWS Certification exam, you must provide valid government-issued identification establishing residence in a non-sanctioned country. If you do not have a qualifying government-issued ID from the country you are testing in (except for candidates who will use a European Union ID), an international travel passport from your country of citizenship is required and must be presented as your primary form of ID. A secondary form of ID is still required. Please review the ID requirement guidelines carefully, as there are different ID requirements for online and in-person testing.

### Payment methods

You can pay for AWS Certification exams using a credit card or voucher. The following credit cards can be used at Pearson VUE: Visa, American Express, Mastercard, and JCB.

Learn more about AWS Certification exam vouchers on our [voucher webpage](https://aws.amazon.com/certification/bulk-voucher/).  

### Test delivery provider terms and conditions

When scheduling an exam with Pearson VUE, you will be prompted to agree to the test delivery provider’s terms and conditions. Be sure to read these terms and conditions carefully before proceeding to schedule your exam.
